page.layout: One page: a blank flyleaf or pastedown with manuscript ownership inscriptions and a shelf mark in ink and pencil. No printed text. Top left: a faded brown inscription. Top right: an ownership inscription in ink. Blue library stamp at upper left (not transcribed). Large pencil shelf mark in the centre. Left edge: a strip of manuscript writing running down the edge of the leaf.
page.notes: Only handwriting and stamps are visible; no printed text is present, so nothing is transcribed as running text. Handwritten ownership note at top right, roughly: "Nicolaj Rippelij Basi- liensis Artium Doctor 1612" (partly illegible). Faded inscription at top left, largely illegible. Pencil shelf mark in the centre reads roughly "kf VII. 18." Blue library stamp at top left is a library stamp and is omitted. The left-edge strip is manuscript writing, not printed matter, and is omitted. Handwriting and stamps are excluded under the page furniture rules.
